description: This file contains shared utility functions for Redux slices, including array normalization, default entity state creation, request lifecycle handlers, and selector builders for entity management within a Redux store.

methods.name: normalizeArray(items = [], getId = (x) => x.id)
methods.description: Normalizes an array of entities into an object with byId map and allIds array, using a provided id selector function.

methods.name: createDefaultEntityState()
methods.description: Creates a default entity state object with byId, allIds, loading, and error properties.

methods.name: onPending
methods.description: Handles the pending state of an async request by setting loading to true and error to null.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Handles a rejected async request by setting loading to false and recording the error message.

methods.name: createEntitySelectors(key)
methods.description: Builds selector functions for accessing entity slice state, including selectById, selectAll, selectIds, selectLoading, and selectError.
